name: planstop gate: a repeated active Stop rail ends the turn instead of continuing forever

source.assertion:
run_hook "$PLAN_STOP_HOOK" \
  "$(codex_stop_input default "$SESSION" 'Repaso\n<!-- oso-plan-approval: v=2 action=IMPLEMENT_THE_PLAN -->' true)"
assert_after_hook "a repeated active Stop rail ends instead of continuing forever" \

hook_returned_continue_false
assert_equals "an active Stop retry writes no approval state" \

expect.stdout: {"continue":false,"stopReason":"oso-code: the approval document must be presented while Codex is still in Plan Mode.","systemMessage":"oso-code: the approval document must be presented while Codex is still in Plan Mode."}
